name: VRM_CREATE_EVENT_DISTS_GT
description: Oracle internal use only. This global temporary table is used in revenue recognition job during internal processing.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Revenue management accounting event unique identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Accounting event type. Values are from the lookup VRM_ACCOUNTING_EVENT_TYPE.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the identifier of the event that triggered the accounting event.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the accounting event.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Original accounting date of the accounting event.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounting event amount in performance obligation currency.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accounting event amount in customer contract currency.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Customer contract number. This is a running sequence number.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_DATE
columns.description: Customer contract date. Used for deriving price effectivity period of the customer contract.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity of the customer contract.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifer of the customer contract.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the initial performance accounting event was created.

columns.name: POL_NET_LINE_AMT
columns.description: Net line amount of performance obligation line.

columns.name: POL_CONTR_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Allocated transaction price of performance obligation line in the contract currency.

columns.name: POL_CONTR_CUR_CARVE_OUT_AMT
columns.description: Discount amount of performance obligation line in the contract currency.

columns.name: POL_ENTERED_CUR_BILLED_AMT
columns.description: Billed amount of performance obligation line in the entered currency.

columns.name: POL_LAST_BE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current event being processed is the last billing event after sorting based on the accounting date under the performance obligation line.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CURRENCY
columns.description: Ledger currency of customer contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CURRENCY_MAU
columns.description: Minimum accountable unit for the contract currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CURRENCY_PRECISION
columns.description: Precision for the contract currency.

columns.name: ENTER_TO_CONTR_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only.

columns.name: ENTER_TO_CONTR_CONV_RATE
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only.

columns.name: ENTER_TO_CONTR_CONV_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY
columns.description: Entered currency of the performance obligation line.

columns.name: SLA_EVENT_CREATION_MODE
columns.description: Oracle Internal use only.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: The allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_AVAILABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the conversion rate is available for the conversion rate date. Possible values are Null or N. Null indicates conversion rate is available.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Accounting event processing status. Values are from the lookup type ORA_ACCOUNTING_EVENT_STATUS.

columns.name: POL_ENTER_CURR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Allocated transaction price of the performance obligation line in the entered currency.

columns.name: POL_ENTER_CURR_CARVE_OUT_AMT
columns.description: Discount amount of the performance obligation line in the entered currency.

columns.name: FOREIGN_CURR_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: The currency conversion treatment used for contract liability accounting distributions when processing foreign currency performance obligations for the ledger. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_FX_CURR_TREATMENT.
